D_shared.meaning: reproducible biology shared across lawful disjoint molecular views and donors
D_shared.selection_substrate: full reader_fit common-core expression with equal donor influence
D_shared.selection_rule: smallest jointly-supported contiguous prefix within one donor-level SE of best held-donor cross-view predictability
D_shared.boundary_rule: if support remains unsaturated at search boundary, expand prospectively; boundary cannot be selected merely because it is the maximum tested

D_private.meaning: additional lawful biological rank in operator-native evidence after D_shared is frozen
D_private.target: incremental prediction of common-core biological state/relations from native evidence, not residual variance and not measurement identity

D_obs.meaning: separate observation/measurement state rank for z_obs
D_obs.selection_rule: smallest rank within one SE of best held-operator reconstruction of lawful observation descriptors; source/matrix identity are never reconstruction targets or free inputs; no biology qualification claim
D_obs.held_source_role: diagnostic generalization stratum only when lawful technology/measurement descriptors are independently mapped; source identity itself is never a target

d_gene.meaning: neural token/attention capacity parameter, not biological dimensionality
d_gene.selection: capacity/hardware preflight after D_total is known; interfaces must be parameterized and cannot impose an inward biological bottleneck

candidate_search_rank.selection: prospectively expandable envelope; every positive integer dimension inside the current envelope is eligible

prospectively_fixed_design_or_risk_contr: anti-concentration policy/cell-repeat cap unless separately superseded by a predeclared derivation rule
hardware_derived_before_training: effective base cells per optimizer update
